company.name: Goobynet
company.shortDescription: Online Marketplace that connects Freelancers to clients from all over the world. Gooby sell both On-site & Online Services
company.description: GOOBY is a two-pronged platform aimed at elevating freelancers by providing work opportunities and assisting project completion by connecting skilled freelancers to projects in need. Freelancers get the opportunity to cash in from their hard work with minimal fees, and businesses and individuals can easily find skilled freelancers. This site not only provides a platform for digital work, but it also accommodates for on-site work, such as event photography, event management, physical tutoring, etc. Through this platform, freelancers have the ability to manage their work within a calendar while buyers can book appointments with freelancers when needed. The platform has an integrated chat function that allows for voice notes, visual material sharing, and lag-free text chatting, ensuring fluid communication between clients and freelancers. Gooby has acquired different channels: a website and two mobile applications, one for clients and another for freelancers. Both mobile applications are available in the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
